reason: Verified in source and by driving master.html?v=approach&state=owner-editing. (1) paintUndo (render-b.js:302-305) prints "Last change: Send the invitations moved 7 days closer." after the button labelled "Move a week earlier" and "... 7 days later." after "Move a week later" — confirmed verbatim in the browser. One gesture carries two names and the pair is not even symmetrical (closer/later), so the receipt does not use the words of the control that caused it. That is a copy defect no gate catches; interaction-check.mjs:440 actually freezes the wrong word in place by asserting /moved 7 days closer/. (2) setVisibility (render-b.js:352) writes no history entry: after switching the item to Hidden the bar still read "Last change: Send the invitations moved 7 days later." The change that decides what a guest sees is unrecorded and un-undoable. (3) The ceiling note is confirmed as "The day itself is in 79 days." sitting one line under a live readout reading "Saturday 3 October 2026 · in 79 days" — it repeats a number in view and never says the press was refused or why. All three are real, specific, and cheap. One sub-claim is factually wrong and must not be carried into the fix: delete does NOT blank the bar. The delete branch (render-b.js:503-514) touches history at all, so after deleting the item the bar kept the stale move receipt and its Undo control stayed live; pressing it popped the entry, found no matching row and silently did nothing. The defect is worse than written, not absent — a live control that claims a change it cannot reverse.
sharpenedFix: Restructure history rather than patching strings, because paintUndo currently formats from top.from/top.to and cannot print a non-move entry. Give every entry a shape { message, num, undo } — message the sentence, num the digit to wrap in span.num so tabular figures survive, undo a closure that restores the previous state. paintUndo then prints entry.message and calls entry.undo() on activation; drop the "Last change: " prefix (it is provably false after a delete, and the bar is role=status so the sentence stands alone). Move entries read "Send the invitations moved 7 days earlier." / "... later.", matching the button labels; update interaction-check.mjs:440 from /Send the invitations moved 7 days closer/ to /Send the invitations moved 7 days earlier/. setVisibility pushes "Send the invitations is now hidden from guests." / "... is now shown to guests." with an undo that flips the toggle back and repaints the segmented control's aria-pressed pair. The delete branch pushes "Send the invitations was removed." with an undo that re-inserts the retained node at its recorded index and calls place(); do not leave the current silent-pop path in place, and add a gate assertion that after a delete the bar names the delete and Undo restores the row count. For the ceiling, do not hardcode "wedding" — the fixture carries the label at F.project.primaryDate.label. Set the note to "This is as far as it goes. " + F.project.primaryDate.label + " is the last day." so it states the refusal and its reason without repeating the readout, and update interaction-check.mjs:402 from /day itself/ to /as far as it goes/.
